第59章 谁也别想糟践他媳妇-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

“你也觉得不行？”赵素梅问。

“周桂芳那个人，咱们心里都清楚得很。”

林国强放下筷子，看着赵素梅，“贪小便宜，手脚也不干净。

她来店里帮忙，今天揣两块肉，明天拿几个鸡蛋，后天偷点卤汤……你抓不抓？

抓了伤和气，不抓亏自己。

到时候闹得难看，还不如一开始就拒绝。”

赵素梅听着，觉得有道理。

周素芳跟她说那会儿，她第一反应就是不行。

但周素芳那个人也难缠的很。

想了想，她问：“要是直接拒绝的话，她会不会闹……”

“闹？”林国强笑了，那笑容里带着一种看透了的淡然，“我现在可不会惯着他们。”

赵素梅不说话了。

她觉得现在的林国强像是带着光，比以前好了不知多少倍。

“她不是真心实意来帮忙的。”

林国强端起碗继续吃饭，“她是来占便宜的，四十块一个月？

志军一个月才三十，她凭什么要四十？

她心里想的是，在你店里干一个月拿四十，再偷偷摸摸往兜里揣点，再吃吃喝喝，再偷学点手艺。

回头她自己开个店，连学费都省了。”

赵素梅倒吸了一口凉气。

她没想到这一层，但林国强一说，她就明白了。

周桂芳那个人，确实干得出来这种事。

“那你怎么回她？”赵素梅问。

“我明天去找大哥。”

林国强把碗里的饭吃完，放下碗，“我跟他说清楚，店里不缺人，让他媳妇别惦记了。”

第二天，林国强去找林国伟。

他没去林国伟家，而是在村口等着。

林国伟每天早上要去采石场干活，七点多从家出来，走村口那条路。

林国强骑自行车等在村口，看见林国伟来了，从车上下来，把自行车支在路边。

“大哥。”

林国伟看见他，脸色就不太好。

上次林国强去他家闹了一通，他心里一直憋着火，但碍于面子没发作。

见林国强叫住他，语气不太好：“啥事？”

“大嫂昨天去我家了，说要来店里帮忙。”

林国强开门见山，“大哥，我跟你说清楚，店里不缺人。

赵志军一个人够用了，不用再添人手。”

"You don't think it's possible either?" Zhao Sumei asked.

"We all know Zhou Guifang very well."

Lin Guoqiang put down his chopsticks and looked at Zhao Sumei, "You are greedy for petty gains and your hands and feet are not clean.

She comes to the store to help. Today she steals two pieces of meat, tomorrow she steals some eggs, and the day after tomorrow she steals some stew... Do you want to catch her?

Catch the injury and be harmonious, but don’t catch yourself at a loss.

By the time it gets ugly, it would be better to reject it from the beginning."

Zhao Sumei listened and felt it made sense.

When Zhou Sufang told her, her first reaction was no.

But Zhou Sufang is also very difficult to deal with.

After thinking about it, she asked: "If she refuses directly, will she make trouble..."

"Are you making trouble?" Lin Guoqiang smiled, with a kind of indifference in his smile, "I won't spoil them now."

Zhao Sumei stopped talking.

She felt that Lin Guoqiang now seemed to be shining with light, and he was countless times better than before.

"She's not really here to help."

Lin Guoqiang picked up the bowl and continued eating, "She's here to take advantage, forty yuan a month?

Zhijun is only thirty in a month, why should she be forty?

What she was thinking about was that she would get forty for a month working in your shop, then secretly put some money in her pocket, eat and drink, and learn some skills secretly.

When she later opened her own shop, she even saved tuition."

Zhao Sumei took a breath of cold air.

She didn't expect this level, but as soon as Lin Guoqiang said it, she understood.

That person Zhou Guifang is indeed capable of such a thing.

"Then how do you reply to her?" Zhao Sumei asked.

"I'll go see big brother tomorrow."

Lin Guoqiang finished the rice in his bowl and put it down, "I made it clear to him that there is no shortage of people in the store and asked his wife not to worry about it."

The next day, Lin Guoqiang went to find Lin Guowei.

He did not go to Lin Guowei's house, but waited at the entrance of the village.

Lin Guowei goes to work in the quarry every morning. He leaves home at around seven o'clock and takes the road at the entrance of the village.

Lin Guoqiang was waiting at the entrance of the village on his bicycle. When he saw Lin Guowei coming, he got out of the car and put his bicycle on the roadside.

"Brother."

Lin Guowei didn't look good when he saw him.

The last time Lin Guoqiang went to his house and caused a scene, he had been holding back his anger, but he didn't break out because of his face.

Seeing Lin Guoqiang calling him, his tone was not good: "What's the matter?"

"Sister-in-law went to my house yesterday and said she would come to the store to help."

Lin Guoqiang got straight to the point, "Brother, let me make it clear to you, there is no shortage of people in the store.

Zhao Zhijun alone is enough, there is no need to add more people."
